name: Financial Refund Review §3.1
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§3.1 Complete and non-conflicting evidence is required. Standard requests beyond 30 days are not eligible for a refund recommendation; Gold requests have a 45-day exception. Amounts above USD 1,000 require specialist escalation. All recommendations require human approval; no automatic payment.

name: Evidence Requirements §4.2
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§4.2 Read the complaint, linked customer, transaction and account. Missing or mismatched records block recommendations. A customer statement conflicting with a merchant record requires escalation and further investigation. Never resolve conflicting evidence solely from a model probability.

name: Vulnerable Customer §2.4
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§2.4 A recorded vulnerability flag requires specialist escalation, respectful communication and human review. Do not infer sensitive characteristics from names or complaint language.

name: Fraud Review §2.1
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§2.1 A declared fraud suspicion flag requires specialist escalation and human review. Neither the historical response-delay model nor the synthetic escalation classifier establishes actual fraud.

name: Financial Hardship §2.2
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§2.2 A hardship request should be referred to an authorised reviewer. Do not promise debt relief or financial entitlement. Request only the minimum relevant supporting material.

name: Chargeback Procedure §5.1
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§5.1 Confirm transaction ownership, amount and evidence before considering a chargeback referral. Missing evidence blocks referral preparation. No external chargeback is submitted by this demo.

name: Customer Communication Standard §1.2
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§1.2 Draft clear factual updates, identify missing evidence and state that a reviewer must confirm the recommendation. Never say money has been sent or a dispute resolved before verified action.

name: Financial Privacy §1.1
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§1.1 Use synthetic identifiers in demonstrations. Do not expose account numbers, personal documents or another session’s data. Privacy complaints require authorised investigation.

name: Specialist Escalation Guide §6.1
text:
Synthetic internal demonstration policy; not legal or regulatory advice.

§6.1 Escalate high-value requests above USD 1,000, vulnerability flags, fraud flags and conflicting evidence. ML scores supply shadow context only; they never override mandatory controls.
